## Results

Upon completion, the process produces:

| Outcome | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🚫 Relationship Terminated | SMA does not share additional information |
| 🔔 Partner Notification | Alert sent to notify business partner of termination |
| 📊 Tracking Information | Data for measuring performance and BAM |

## Constraints & Failures

- **Constraints**: SMA and business partners agree on termination message content. Content depends on relationship and is standards-based.
- **Potential Failures**:
    - Information does not comply with syntax criteria
    - Not all required information provided
    - Information provided not authenticated
